description:
No spec subject — bookkeeping epic.

Impromptu epic created 2026-07-27 to land 21 independently-surfaced follow-up tickets on a SINGLE PR, extending the 0.10.0 release already opened on the specled_-td7 branch. Children were each carved by an earlier ticket cold verification, critical review, or the 0.9.6 fast-follow sweep, and had no owning epic.

## BASE AND ALREADY-LANDED WORK

This epic branches from feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors at e81f9f98, NOT from main. That branch is 10 commits ahead of main and 0 behind, and already carries two implemented + cold-verified tickets that ship on this same PR:
  - specled_-td7  gate forensics + self-identifying failing-test descriptors (IMPLEMENTED, VERIFY: PASS)
  - specled_-n5s  Store.write_v2/2 ArgumentError contract (IMPLEMENTED, VERIFY: PASS)
It also already bumped VERSION to 0.10.0 and opened the CHANGELOG entry. Do NOT re-bump; extend the existing 0.10.0 section.

## ADMISSION VERIFICATION (2026-07-27)

All 22 candidate tickets were cold-verified against the td7 tree by one fresh-context agent each before this epic was formed. Result: zero were already_done, zero obsolete. One premise_wrong (specled_-4pl) and three partially_done (specled_-26g, specled_-npo, specled_-4f7) had their mandates narrowed or rewritten during admission — see the per-ticket ADMISSION comments. specled_-4a6 was verified still_applicable but CUT from this epic by user decision; see its comment.

## SEQUENCING RATIONALE

Waves are derived from a file-collision map, not from caution. Every serialization below names the file the two tickets share; tickets with disjoint file sets run concurrently.

Wave 1 (11, fully parallel): wby, ako, yds, vbo, pii, ehv, dn4.12, npo, zek, z5t, chb, 4pl
Wave 2 (7, each behind exactly one Wave-1 ticket): 26g<-ehv, asb<-ehv, zd8<-dn4.12, b23<-dn4.12, ozm<-4pl+ehv, 14t<-zek, 4f7<-pii
Wave 3 (2): xkn.1<-26g+npo, xkn.2<-z5t+ozm

Orchestrated by /orchestrate-epic.

comments.text:
Worktree: /Users/mz/src/specled_ex-specled--k6s-fast-follow
Branch: epic/specled_-k6s-0.10.0-fast-follow
Base: e81f9f98 (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors HEAD; 10 commits ahead of main, 0 behind)

Epic smoke green at creation: mix deps.get, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix test => 3 properties, 1272 tests, 0 failures. (A mismatched-delimiter parse error in the output is an intentional negative-path tracer-bootstrap probe fixture, not a failure.)

NOTE: this worktree needed `mix deps.get` before first compile. Every stage worktree will too - run it as part of stage smoke, before treating red as real.

## RELEASE

VERSION is already 0.10.0 and the CHANGELOG 0.10.0 section is already open, both from the td7 branch. Do NOT bump again. Extend the existing 0.10.0 section; the orchestrator consolidates CHANGELOG.md once in Wave 4 rather than letting 21 agents append to it.

## REPO ORCHESTRATION SURFACE

.claude/rules/worktree.md references `make worktree-new` and `make smoke`, but THIS repo Makefile has neither (targets: help, clean, deps, format, test, compile, check). Use plain `git worktree add ../specled_ex-<slug> -b <stage-branch> <base_sha>` - the precedent set by specled_-233. Stage smoke = mix deps.get && mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test.

Not a sasa1977/boundary repo, so BOUNDARY_DELTA_LABELED=0 for every child and the boundary gate is inert.

## MERGE GATE (host mix, no compose)

mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check

Hash inputs for the unchanged-tree skip: lib, test, config, priv, mix.lock, .spec

## GENERATED / DERIVED STATE POLICY

- .spec/state.json - derived, untracked, gitignored; never review scope, never committed. Regenerate with `mix spec.index --output .spec/state.json`.
- .spec/realization_hashes.json - COMMITTED baseline, NOT free generated state. Per .claude/rules/specled.md a rebase worker must NOT resolve conflicts here by regenerating; that silently absorbs realization drift. FOR THIS EPIC: no child may touch it at all. specled_-4a6, the only hash-mover in the candidate set, was cut. Every remaining child cold-verified as hash-neutral (private-function, comment, test, and doc edits; api_boundary hashes public export heads only). ANY hash diff from a child is a red flag - investigate, do not accept, do not regenerate.

## AGENT-RULES CAVEAT (affects specled_-pii and specled_-4f7)

.claude/rules/{specled,beadwork,testing}.md carry `<!-- agent-rules: generated v0.13.2 -->`. A future resync can revert edits made there. Editing them in place is nonetheless the established repo practice - commit 134d0e8d edited .claude/rules/specled.md as ordinary feature work in the 0.8.0 release, and 6fe5b776 shows resyncs are explicit deliberate commits, not automatic. So: edit in place, and the PR body MUST carry a note that the pii and 4f7 changes need carrying upstream into agent-rules at the next resync. .claude/rules/worktree.md is hand-written (no marker) and unaffected.

## ACCEPTANCE BAR: FALSIFIABILITY

Five children (ako, ozm, yds, zek, asb) mandate proving a new assertion RED under a named mutation. "Tests pass" is not evidence for these. Require the mutation and its revert in the commit message; bounce otherwise.

## FLAKE POLICY

tagged_tests verification legs are load-flaky under concurrency. Never run bare `mix spec.check` while implementation agents are running - agents use `--no-run-commands`; exactly one serial bare run in Wave 4. Re-run a single red leg serially before treating it as real.

## BRANCH-GUARD NOISE

dn4.12, xkn.2 and chb will trip branch-guard subject drift. Resolve with `Spec-Drift:` commit trailers, as the base branch already does on every commit - never by weakening spec prose, and never by adding a false `decisions:` link to prose_guard.spec.md.

## ADMISSION PROVENANCE

Every child carries an ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment with its scoped mandate, expected touches, and risk notes, produced by one cold fresh-context agent per ticket run against this exact base tree. For 4pl, b23, 26g, npo and 4f7 that comment SUPERSEDES the original description - implement the admitted mandate, not the description. Notably: 4pl as written would write false numbers into an ADR, and b23 item 1 as written is impossible (mix spec.triangle filters aggregate findings to detector_unavailable only, spec.triangle.ex:376).
